title: Admin operational guardrails: export controls & network allowlist UI + RBAC v2 mapping
creator: Marco Alvarez
description:
Summary: Add a single Admin 'Operational Guardrails' screen and API surface that consolidates compliance controls (IP allowlist, disable public sharing, export/data egress controls) and maps them to RBAC v2 roles and audit logging events. Goal is to give org admins clear toggleable controls plus deterministic enforcement in both Hosted and Dedicated modes.

Scope:
- Admin Console UI: new Operational Guardrails page under Organization Settings. Includes grouped toggles for: IP Allowlist (global and per-route exceptions), Public Sharing (disable link sharing and external sharing), Data Export Controls (disable CSV/JSON exports, S3/Cloud export endpoints, and API bulk export).
- Backend enforcement: config persisted in org config store; enforcement middleware that rejects requests that violate guardrails or routes to compliant fallback (e.g., block export, route to redacted response).
- RBAC v2 mapping: map toggles to roles/permissions so org admins can delegate management rights; introduce two new permissions: guardrails.read and guardrails.manage.
- Audit logging: add structured audit events for toggle changes, attempted blocked actions (export attempts, share link created when disabled), and allowlist bypass requests. Ensure events include actor identity (SSO subject), IP, route, reason, and pre/post config.
- SSO/SAML: Ensure SAML-provisioned group-to-role mappings can grant guardrails.manage; document behavior when SCIM sync removes admin role.
- API: add GET/PUT endpoints under /orgs/{org_id}/guardrails with proper permission checks and rate limits.

Out of scope:
- Per-resource policy language (we will follow org-level toggles for MVP).
- Automated remediation for repeated export attempts (future work).

Acceptance criteria:
- Admins can view and update guardrail toggles in Console and via API; updates require guardrails.manage and emit audit events.
- Any export/share action blocked by guardrails returns a 403 with structured error code 'guardrail_blocked' and logs an audit event.
- IP allowlist enforced at request ingress; when a request originates outside allowlist we return 403 and log reasons.
- RBAC v2 has two new permissions and the Console exposes role assignment UI for them.
- End-to-end tests for Hosted and Dedicated ensure enforcement and audit events are present in org audit log with required fields.

Implementation notes / trade-offs:
- Storage model: store guardrail config as a single versioned JSON blob in the org-config table to allow atomic rollbacks. This simplifies reads but requires caution for concurrent updates.
- Enforcement point: prefer middleware in API gateway service for IP allowlist and share/export checks to minimize late-stage enforcement gaps. Some legacy endpoints will need adapter wrappers.
- Audit volume: blocking/export-attempt events could be high. We'll batch/stream to the existing event pipeline with a dedicated event type to allow downstream sampling if needed.
- RBAC change migration: RBAC v2 already supports custom permissions; adding guardrails.manage/read should be additive. We'll provide a migration script to map existing org-admin roles to include guardrails.manage where appropriate.

Rollout plan:
1) Feature flag: ship enforcement behind an org-level feature flag 'guardrails_mvp' default OFF.
2) Internal dogfood: enable for Redwood internal org and one pilot customer.
3) Phased enablement: enable for orgs that opt in; monitor audit event rate and false positives for 2 weeks.
4) Global rollout when stable, with admin-facing migration notice.

Testing plan:
- Unit tests for storage, permission checks, and audit event payloads.
- Integration tests simulating SSO-provisioned admin user toggling guardrails.
- E2E tests: blocked export and share scenarios in Hosted and Dedicated.
- Load test: simulate burst of attempted exports to validate event pipeline and error rates.

Monitoring/observability:
- New Console dashboard tile: guardrails change frequency, blocked-action rate, top blocked user/IPs, and recent toggle changes.
- Alerts: spike in guardrail-blocked events or spike in failed admin updates (403s).

Documentation & compliance:
- Confluence: "Org Guardrails (Admin controls)" runbook describing toggles, enforcement semantics, and migration.
- Update security policy docs to reference new audit events and retention.
- Provide customer-facing docs describing behavior and examples for SSO mappings.

Privacy/Legal note:
- Audit logs include IPs and user identifiers; ensure retention and access controls align with compliance packages (we will add a toggle to scrub IPs for customers who require pseudonymized logs, tracked in a follow-up ticket).
